findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tool_compute_sandbox, tool_sa_airport_oracle · Public sink: tool_zar_prices, tool_data_transformer, tool_compute_sandbox, tool_sa_airport_oracle · Destructive: tool_zar_prices, tool_data_transformer, tool_compute_sandbox, tool_sa_airport_oracle.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tool_compute_sandbox, tool_sa_airport_oracle · Public sink: tool_zar_prices, tool_data_transformer, tool_compute_sandbox, tool_sa_airport_oracle · Destructive: tool_zar_prices, tool_data_transformer, tool_compute_sandbox, tool_sa_airport_oracle

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
